brand.notes: Hitachi AC for PK market (Hitachi Global Air; residential Shiroi/airHome/split + light-commercial + SET FREE / Utopia-IVX-Prime wired controller lines). Primary sources: official Utopia/IVX/Prime service manual SMGB0136 (61 high) + SET FREE air365 wired alarm table (65 high) + Primairy GB distributor bulletin (35 medium-high, Logicool + yorknow corroboration) + light-commercial 10.2 ALARM CODES (15 medium-high) + residential timer blink map (7 medium-high) + airHome LD301 outdoor blink (14 medium-high) + Snowflake RAC mirror (9 medium). Multiple code schemes (blink-count, LD301 blink, ABNML numeric, E-prefix, hex/hex alarm) kept in separate series files — same digits across product lines never merged. No consolidated PK-facing official table (no hitachiaircon.com/pk; Incapsula-gated documentation). Quarantines: Hitachi IT/storage/elevator, other regions as corroboration only, other-brand tables.
